rawContent: I’ve donated to #reclaimtheblock to redirect funds from Minneapolis police towards ways that actually promote the city’s health & safety. There are many other organizations that can also use your support in their list below 👇👇👇 #BlackLivesMatter #JusticeforGerogeFloyd

Police brutality is terrifying, even more so when protests are used as an excuse to step up the violence. An unconscionable abuse of power, now & historically #BlackLivesMatter #BLM #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd https://t.co/wTgrBYnJm8

Partner & 6-month-old baby are at a #BlackLivesMatter protest. I’m at home working on my novel, because writing time is PRECIOUS. But I’m there in spirit! #BlackLivesMatterUK #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd #JusticeforBreonnaTaylor #BLM

#PublishingPaidMe is a sobering insight into how race affects how much authors are paid & valued by the publishing industry. Pay disparities result in real, material differences in the lives of authors & that ultimately impacts WHO can keep writing & whose books are read. #BLM 👇

‘I’ve found #BorisJohnson to be deeply offensive. One of the first things he tried to do as Mayor of multicultural London was get rid of Black History Month.’ @BernardineEvari speaks for many of us on #bbcqt #BlackLivesMatterUK #BlackLivesMatter

I have all respect for this. Black leaders & activists have for decades led the charge for more equal representation, inclusion & systemic change, thereby raising the roof for all of us in minority groups #BlackLivesMatter #BlackWritersGuild #PublishingPaidMe #PublishingSoWhite
I enjoyed chatting with @NickyVincentPH for her #podcast - on trauma, recovery & how our society talks about sexual assault. Thanks for inviting me on! #activism #MeToo #StrongerTogether

Thanks to @NickyVincentPH for our chat on @this_strong her #podcast on resilience & overcoming life obstacles. I spoke about my love of #solotravel - it was both an incentive for me to recover from my #rape and a solution in itself. #MeToo #DarkChapter https://t.co/3NmWUIetpg https://t.co/yCDeOgN5of

'Literary agents claim finding quality BAME authors is a major challenge for them.' But um... there's LOADS of writing talent in BAME communities. As @SharLovegrove  @emma_a_paterson can attest in this article 👇👇👇#BlackLivesMatter #publishingpaidme 

https://t.co/UknwOxr5Zv

Congrats to fellow survivor & activist @BonnyTurner1212 who along with @centreWJ @EVAWuk has forced the state's lamentable record on rape cases to be re-evaluated 👏#RapeJusticeNow #endVAWG #MeToo  @Angles_project

While we were in lockdown, I enjoyed delivering talks in these online @sounddelivery workshops for other changemakers about speaking out about our lived experience. Read about it in their blog post! 👇👇 #activism #MeToo #strongertogether

Here it is!!! Writing this piece on #IMayDestroyYou @MichaelaCoel for @SightSoundmag was very satisfying for both the film buff AND the rape survivor in me. Here’s to telling our own stories, on our own terms ✍️ #MeToo #endVAWG #IMayDestroyYouhbo👇👇👇

This is disturbing. Individuals in Victoria can no longer publicly  identify themselves as victims of rape, without facing legal consequences. That only serves to silence survivors & rob us of the right to tell our stories. #endVAWG #MeToo #VAWG  https://t.co/MziJ5mO03y

I’m in London but about to give this talk now to @YPO Women’s Business Network in Asia - amazing how Covid can widen our sense of global community & storytelling through technology. I’ll be talking about trauma, recovery & resilience #DarkChapter #StrongerTogether #MeToo https://t.co/U3i6Lchnp7
